Title: SkyeBrowse updates pricing with new tools for drone 3D mapping
Summary: SkyeBrowse has updated its pricing structure for its drone 3D mapping platform to better cater to the needs of users. The company has introduced three new plans, each designed to suit the specific use cases of teams that capture 3D models with drones. This move is intended to provide more flexibility and affordability for users.

Title: DJI wants drone pilots to turn heritage sites into 3D flythroughs
Summary: DJI is launching a global competition to encourage drone pilots to document and preserve heritage sites using 3D mapping and flythrough videos. The World Heritage 3D Conservation Initiative challenges pilots to create detailed 3D models of natural and cultural sites, highlighting the potential for drones to play a role in conservation efforts. By capturing these sites in 3D, pilots can help preserve these sites for future generations.

Title: FCC clears nationwide test of cellular networks for drones
Summary: The FCC has approved a nationwide test of cellular networks for drones, allowing them to potentially use commercial cell towers for connectivity and tracking. The test aims to explore the feasibility of integrating drones into the existing cellular network infrastructure.

Title: US Marine Corps share videos of what training with drones looks like
Summary: US Marines have shared videos showing their drone training exercises, providing a glimpse into their integration of drones into common units, from early training to large-scale exercises. The training aims to enhance the Marines' ability to work with drones in various operations. The videos showcase the Marines' efforts to develop their drone capabilities.

Title: ABZ Innovation opens massive new drone production hub in Europe
Summary: ABZ Innovation has opened a massive new drone production hub in Szentendre, Hungary, one of the largest dedicated civilian drone production sites in Europe, to meet growing demand for drones in various industries. The facility focuses on civilian work, including agricultural spraying, industrial cleaning, and cargo operations. The expansion aims to capitalize on the growing need for drones in these sectors.
